title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn About Safety Rules
summary: Today, Baby Leo and friends learn about safety rules! Marjona teaches them how to be safe while playing and exploring. Together, they discover that following safety rules keeps everyone happy and healthy.
lesson: Kids learn important safety rules for playing and exploring.
beats: The friends are playing in the sunny park. Baby Leo remembers the fun of their last adventure. He suggests they explore the park today.
Marjona joins them, excited to play. She remembers their last lesson about friendship and how important it is to look out for each other.
As they play, Marjona has a clever idea. She wants to teach the group about safety rules while they have fun.
The friends gather around Marjona. She explains that safety rules help keep everyone safe when they're playing.
Marjona shows them how to look both ways before crossing a path. Bella hops excitedly, pretending to cross safely.
Next, they practice walking carefully on the grass. Bobo joins them, making funny faces while walking carefully.
Marjona reminds them to stay close to each other while exploring. Baby Leo realizes that they can help keep each other safe.
After practicing their safety rules, the friends feel proud. They know they can have fun and be safe together.
They decide to explore a little further. With Marjona leading, they find a beautiful tree and share a happy dance around it.
The friends cheer together, celebrating their new safety skills. They promise to always remember to look out for each other.
